  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: medium. Era: 2025–2026.
  - Cases: [GitHub: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-went-wrong), [Spotify: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: None found.
- **AGF-6** [ours] Make each agent session discardable as a unit; one unchecked assumption forced a whole session to be rolled back.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: weak. Era: 2026.
  - Cases: [1Password: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: None found.
- **AGF-7** [stated] Output varies between runs on the same input: plan retries, pick among passing attempts, and contain the variance in production migrations.
  - Old system as oracle: partly. Strength: medium. Era: internal Gemini to 2026.
  - Cases: [Google: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#what-went-wrong), [1Password: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#what-went-wrong), [Spotify: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: None found.
  - Sceptic: tag changed from no to partly. Challenge: picking among passing attempts needs something to pass, and here that was the old regression suite. Answer: accepted; any oracle will do, but one is needed.
- **AGF-8** [stated] Check how well the model handles each language in scope; one poorly supported language fell back to people.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: weak. Era: internal Gemini; likely era-bound.
  - Cases: [Google: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: None found.

## Human oversight (oversight.md)

Where people stay in the loop, and what they guard.

- **OVS-1** [stated] The agent that changes the code must not change what counts as correct: edits to tests, snapshots, baselines and waiver labels need a separate owner's approval.
  - Old system as oracle: partly. Strength: strong. Era: 2025–2026.
  - Cases: [GitHub: practices to copy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#practices-to-copy), [GitHub: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-went-wrong), [Spotify: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#what-went-wrong), [Bun: how it was checked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#how-it-was-checked), [Intel: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-08-24-intel-ideas-c-to-rust.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: None found.
- **OVS-2** [stated] Keep the final merge with a person who checks how the agent answered CI and review, not only the diff.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: 2024–2026.
  - Cases: [GitHub: how it was checked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#how-it-was-checked), [Google: how it was checked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#how-it-was-checked), [Slack: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md#who-did-what).
  - Against: Disagree: in Bun no person read every line; the engineer checked the reviewers instead ([Bun](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#how-it-was-checked)), and an outside critic calls it unreviewed.
- **OVS-3** [stated] Decide up front where automation stops (a retry cap, a residue size, a category for people) and hand over with the failed attempt as the starting point.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: 2023–2026.
  - Cases: [Airbnb: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#what-worked), [Airbnb: practices to copy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#practices-to-copy), [1Password: practices to copy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#practices-to-copy), [Google: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#who-did-what).
  - Against: Uber's stop rule was a revert to the old framework, not a hand-over to people ([Uber](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-07-uber-junit4-to-junit5.md#what-went-wrong)).

## Knowledge capture (knowledge.md)

Turning failures and logs into lasting improvements.

- **KNW-1** [stated] When a failure recurs, fix what generates the code (prompt, reviewer rule, skill, evaluation, harness), not only the output; the second time is the trigger.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: 2024–2026.
  - Cases: [Bun: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#what-worked), [GitHub: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-worked), [Airbnb: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#what-worked), [Uber: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-07-uber-junit4-to-junit5.md#what-worked).
  - Against: None found.
- **KNW-2** [stated] Stamp each unit with its status, tune against the largest failing group using a small sample, then sweep all units again.
  - Old system as oracle: partly. Strength: strong. Era: 2023–2025.
  - Cases: [Airbnb: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#what-worked), [Slack: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md#what-worked), [Google: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#what-worked), [Uber: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-07-uber-junit4-to-junit5.md#what-worked).
  - Against: None found.
- **KNW-3** [stated] Keep structured session logs from the start; they later answered where time went and what people did, and became evaluations.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: medium. Era: 2026.
  - Cases: [GitHub: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#numbers), [GitHub: what worked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-worked).
  - Against: None found.

## Measuring and reading results (measurement.md)

How to read the numbers in these sources, and how to report your own.

- **MSR-1** [ours] Treat savings measured against a manual effort that never ran as self-estimates; record the basis beside each figure and never add them across cases.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: all.
  - Cases: [Google: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#what-went-wrong), [Spotify: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#numbers), [Airbnb: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#numbers), [Slack: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md#numbers), [Bun: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#numbers), [1Password: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: Google's estimate at least agrees with its measured shares of model-made edits ([Google](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#numbers)).
- **MSR-2** [ours] For every success rate ask out of what (attempted, opened, merged, dropped from scope), and report each measure with its base; bases differed several-fold.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: all.
  - Cases: [Spotify: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#what-went-wrong), [Slack: how it was checked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md#how-it-was-checked).
  - Against: Airbnb's main rate covers its whole file set ([Airbnb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#numbers)).
- **MSR-3** [ours] Weigh each source by the author's stake in the tool (seller, owner, partner); none of the eight had outside measurement.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: all.
  - Cases: [Bun: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#who-did-what), [GitHub: context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#context), [Spotify: context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#context), [1Password: context](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#context), [Intel: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-08-24-intel-ideas-c-to-rust.md#who-did-what).
  - Against: Google lists its own threats to validity ([Google](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#what-went-wrong)), and Slack has no stake in the model it used.
- **MSR-4** [stated] Credit a gain to the migration only after separating it from work that landed in the same window (other speed work, linker changes, unrelated fixes).
  - Old system as oracle: partly. Strength: medium. Era: 2026.
  - Cases: [GitHub: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-went-wrong), [Bun: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: Disagree: the Zig creator credits link-time optimisation the old toolchain already had for Bun's speed-up ([Bun](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#what-went-wrong)).
- **MSR-5** [stated] Escaped defects are unknown by nature: publish known regressions as a floor, grouped by cause, and use a before-and-after proxy labelled as a proxy.
  - Old system as oracle: partly. Strength: medium. Era: 2026.
  - Cases: [GitHub: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-went-wrong), [Bun: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: Airbnb reports no defects after merge at all, which is missing data, not evidence ([Airbnb](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md#what-went-wrong)).
- **MSR-6** [ours] Activity numbers (lines per minute, commits, merged changes) are not progress; track verified behaviour or the shrinking list of remaining sites.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: medium. Era: all.
  - Cases: [Bun: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#numbers), [Spotify: numbers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#numbers), [GitHub: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: None found.
- **MSR-7** [ours] Re-date a lesson before reusing it: early negative results, and results from pre-release or restricted models, may not hold for the models you use.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: medium. Era: Claude 2.1 (2024) to pre-release models (2026).
  - Cases: [Slack: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md#who-did-what), [Bun: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#who-did-what), [Intel: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-08-24-intel-ideas-c-to-rust.md#who-did-what), [Google: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#what-went-wrong), [Uber: what went wrong](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-07-uber-junit4-to-junit5.md#what-went-wrong).
  - Against: 1Password's 2026 agents still broke ordering rules ([1Password](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#what-went-wrong)), so some failures persist across eras.
- **MSR-8** [ours] Do not credit the model with work the deterministic tools did: finding sites, building manifests and codemods were often the hard part.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: strong. Era: all.
  - Cases: [Google: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#who-did-what), [Slack: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md#who-did-what), [1Password: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md#who-did-what), [Spotify: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md#who-did-what), [Uber: who did what](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-07-uber-junit4-to-junit5.md#who-did-what).
  - Against: In Bun almost all the work ran through agent workflows ([Bun](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md#who-did-what)).
- **MSR-9** [stated] If you will claim savings, measure people's share from file snapshots or logs from day one; estimates from the tool's own builders are biased.
  - Old system as oracle: no. Strength: medium. Era: internal Gemini.
  - Cases: [Google: how it was checked](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#how-it-was-checked), [Google: practices to copy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md#practices-to-copy).
  - Against: None found.

## Cases

- [GitHub moves its Copilot agent runtime from TypeScript to Rust using agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-09-16-github-copilot-runtime-rust.md) — language, TypeScript on Node.js and V8 to Rust (native library with a C ABI); AI share: most; evidence: shown-in-source; author: seller-of-tool; cost: ~$120,000 for ~136.3 billion tokens (engineer time not priced). One engineer steered agent fleets to port about 430,000 lines of TypeScript to Rust in place, one component per PR, over 14.5 weeks.
- [Intel's IDEAS harness ports the libgit2 command-line client from C to safe Rust](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-08-24-intel-ideas-c-to-rust.md) — language, C (libgit2 command-line client) to safe Rust (no unsafe code); AI share: most; evidence: shown-in-source; author: seller-of-tool; cost: ~$0.55 per symbol for translation (total unstated), plus ~$6.5 for repair. An LLM harness turned 112K lines of C into safe Rust that compiled but crashed; 8 person-hours guiding an agent got git blame working.
- [Bun moves its JavaScript runtime off Zig onto Rust with Claude agents in 11 days](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-07-08-bun-zig-to-rust.md) — language, Zig (Bun runtime, bundler, package manager, test runner) to Rust (about 100 crates); AI share: most; evidence: shown-in-source; author: seller-of-tool; cost: ~$165,000 at API list prices for the tokens used before merge (690 million output tokens, 5.9 billion fresh input tokens, 72 billion cached input tokens). One engineer ran about 50 Claude Code workflows, up to 64 agents at once, to port 535K lines of Zig to Rust; all tests passed and it merged in 11 days.
- [1Password uses AI agents to refactor its Go monolith and begin a service extraction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-20-1password-monolith-refactor.md) — architecture, Go monolith (B5), database transactions opened with MustBegin (panics on failure) to separately owned services; transaction calls that return errors; AI share: unstated; evidence: assertion-only; author: user-of-tool; cost: unstated. Agents rewrote over 3,000 panicking transaction calls from a tight spec, but stumbled on a service extraction's ordering and invariants.
- [Uber moves 75K test classes from JUnit 4 to JUnit 5 with OpenRewrite; an AI attempt failed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2026-04-07-uber-junit4-to-junit5.md) — test-framework, Java tests on JUnit 4 in a Bazel monorepo to Java tests on JUnit 5 (Jupiter engine on the JUnit Platform); AI share: little; evidence: assertion-only; author: user-of-tool; cost: unstated. Contrast case. Rule-based OpenRewrite recipes moved over 75,000 Java test classes onto JUnit 5; a generative-AI attempt failed and AI only helped debug.
- [Spotify runs fleet-wide migrations with its Honk background coding agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-11-06-spotify-honk.md) — mixed, many (for example Java AutoValue classes, old Scio versions, deprecated datasets) to many (for example Java records, the newest Scio, new dataset versions); AI share: most; evidence: assertion-only; author: seller-of-tool; cost: unstated. Spotify put a coding agent inside its fleet migration tooling; verifiers and an LLM judge gate each PR, and over 1,500 agent PRs were merged.
- [Google widens int32 IDs to int64 in 39 migrations with an LLM pipeline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-13-google-int64-ids.md) — data, int32 ID fields in protocol buffer schemas and the code using them (Java, C++, Dart and others) to int64 ID fields; AI share: most; evidence: shown-in-source; author: seller-of-tool; cost: unstated. A nightly pipeline of code search, rule-based sorting, an internal Gemini model and staged checks drafted 74.45% of 595 code changes in 39 ID migrations.
- [Airbnb moves 3.5K React test files off Enzyme onto React Testing Library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2025-04-01-airbnb-enzyme-to-rtl.md) — test-framework, Enzyme (React component tests) to React Testing Library; AI share: most; evidence: assertion-only; author: user-of-tool; cost: unstated. An LLM pipeline with per-file validation steps and retries migrated 97% of about 3,500 React test files; people finished the rest by hand.
- [Slack pairs a syntax-tree codemod with Claude 2.1 to help move 15K Enzyme tests to React Testing Library](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ntroccoli/ai-migrations/main/cases/2024-05-22-slack-enzyme-to-rtl.md) — test-framework, Enzyme (React unit and integration tests) to React Testing Library; AI share: unstated; evidence: shown-in-source; author: user-of-tool; cost: unstated. Codemod alone 45% (evaluation files), Claude 2.1 alone 40-60% (base not given), both 80% of code in 9 checked files; 22% of tests passed over 338 files.
